data.long_meaning: Evana is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Vayana', which refers to a goddess of prosperity and wealth in Hindu mythology. This name is believed to bring good fortune and abundance to the one who bears it. The name Evana carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Evana usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Evana holds significant cultural value in Hindu society as it is rooted in the rich mythology of ancient India. It carries the resonance of Vayana, a revered goddess of prosperity and wealth, who is often depicted with a hundred hands, each holding the symbol of abundance - a pot of gold or a grain of rice. The name is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, wealth, and fortune to the one who bears it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Evana signifies the principle of wealth and prosperity inherent in all beings. It is a reminder that wealth and abundance are not just financial gifts but also the gifts of good health, meaningful relationships, happiness, and inner peace. The name Evana invites us to cultivate an attitude of gratitude for the abundance in our lives and to use our material possessions to uplift ourselves and others. This name inspires us to recognize that true prosperity is not measured by the numbers in our bank accounts but by the richness of our hearts and the depth of our inner wisdom.
